title: A backup still being made when the door's wait runs out answers 202 and is said as still being made, a second press starts no second backup, and a failed backups read is said instead of an empty list
steps: S1: POST /api/sites/:key/backup on a WordPress, a Joomla and an EmDash site whose host job is still running when the two-minute wait ends; press again while the host still says running.
S2: POST /backup when an older webroot-backup row says running but the host says done; and when the host fails the job.
S3: Classify Create a backup answers: 202, no answer, a proxy's 504, an unreadable answer, FLEET_JOB_FAILED, 4xx, 429.

S4: In the Site changes tab (browser fixture): press Create backup against 202, against a 504, against FLEET_JOB_FAILED; Restore everything against a failed operation; open the tab while /backups answers 502, and while it answers 404.
expect: S1: 202 {code: BACKUP_PENDING} both times, one host job filed, no site.backup audit row.
S2: a new backup is made (200, version 4) and the old row reads done; a failed job is still 502 FLEET_JOB_FAILED.
S3: pending, unconfirmed, unconfirmed, unconfirmed, failed, failed, rate-limited.

S4: [data-backup-outcome=pending] "Still making the backup"; [data-backup-outcome=unconfirmed] "Result not confirmed yet"; neither says "Nothing on the site was changed", the host failure does; Restore everything failed reads "The restore did not go through"; [data-backups-failed] above the list on 502, nothing on 404.
evidence: Plan #1403 item 9 (code read 16/10/2026): runSiteJob returns pending:true at the 120 s deadline but the door answered 502 FLEET_JOB_FAILED reason timeout; the dialog read it as "The backup could not be made. Nothing on the site was changed." while the host went on, so a second press made a second backup; Restore everything showed the files undo's "The undo did not go through"; a failed /backups read drew the list with no backup at all, the Initial backup included
fence: One backup at a time per site, checked against the host; only a refusal says nothing was made

tests: POST /api/sites/:key/backup (wordpress): still being made at the deadline is 202 BACKUP_PENDING with no audit row, and a second press starts no second backup
POST /api/sites/:key/backup (joomla): still being made at the deadline is 202 BACKUP_PENDING with no audit row, and a second press starts no second backup
POST /api/sites/:key/backup (emdash): still being made at the deadline is 202 BACKUP_PENDING with no audit row, and a second press starts no second backup
POST /api/sites/:key/backup: once the host ended the backup that held the door, the next press makes a new one
POST /api/sites/:key/backup: a host that failed the backup is still a 502 FLEET_JOB_FAILED
Create a backup: only a refusal is "failed"; a 202, a lost answer or an unreadable one may still end in a backup
Create a backup still being made (202): says so, never "Nothing on the site was changed"; the list watches for it
Create a backup with no answer that proves anything (a proxy’s 504): not confirmed, never "Nothing was changed"
Create a backup the host failed: "could not be made", the dialog stays
Restore everything failed on the host: its own words, not the undo’s
the backups could not be read: the list says so above everything, instead of showing a site with no backup
no backups door (404): no milestones and nothing said, as before
